text:
maria: FYI PR #457 touches the model catalog card for cassiopeia-2b-embed — updates supported input length, clarifies throughput units, and adds an SDK snippet. Need quick QA before merge. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/457 :eyes:
docs-bot: PR opened by @sam - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/457

alex: quick skim — main thing: doc says "throughput: 1,200 embeds/s" but doesn't specify measurement (CPU vs GPU, batch size). can we standardize on `embeds/sec @ batch=32 on p4d` ?

sam: yeah that's my bad. bench was on p4d with batch=32 and fp16. i'll update.

jin: also the limit note says "max input 8192 tokens" — for embeddings we often use character-length guidance for users. can we change to "8192 tokens (~65k chars)" or better: give both token and char guidance.

maria: +1 to both. also there's an inline python snippet that uses an old SDK call `client.embed()` — we upgraded to `client.embeddings.create()` in SDK v3. need patch.

sam: here's updated snippet i tested locally:
```python
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
resp = client.embeddings.create(
    model='cassiopeia-2b-embed',
    input=['short text', 'longer blob...'],
    batch_size=32
)
print(len(resp.data[0].embedding))
```

alex: looks good. can you add a small note about preferred batch_size choices (8 / 16 / 32) and latency tradeoffs? a one-line bullet is enough.

jin: Also add a fallback example for long docs: recommend chunking to 1024 tokens and averaging embeddings, or using `orion-embed-large` for single-shot inputs >8k chars.

leo: i'm +1 for merge once wording fixed and bench numbers added. i'll do final pass.

sam: updated PR: changed units to "embeds/sec @ batch=32 (p4d, fp16)", added token/character guidance, and replaced SDK call. added fallback paragraph with chunking example and link to embed-aggregation guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/embed-aggregation

maria: can we also add an automated bench link? alex, can you upload the raw bench logs to the PR?

alex: uploading now. log: `bench/embed/cassiopeia/2166001234.log` — peak 1240 embeds/s, p95 latency 55ms @ batch=32

docs-bot: CI docs lint: 1 warning — broken link in "compatibility notes" line. broken path was /models/orion-embed -> should be /models/orion-embed-large

sam: fixed link, pushed.

maria: thanks all. plan: wait 24h for final reviews, then merge. Assigning to @leo to merge after green CI. :white_check_mark:

leo: got it. will merge after CI passes.

alex: small follow-up: can we add a tiny note in the runtime docs about how prefix caching affects embedding latency for repeated prefixes? platform/infra team might find it useful.

maria: add a follow-up issue pls. @alex create issue and ping eng-runtime.

alex: done: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/812

maria: closing loop — thanks everyone. :sparkles:
